teaser: A bike repair stand holds the wheel still so a single hand can true it, spoke by spoke, without rushing. Life path 2 moves like that, and carried inside an INFP, the patience picks up a private undertone. Both are built around closeness — one spoke pulled toward another until the rim comes even — but this crossing asks the closeness to feel honest, not only balanced. The quiet work of the 2 and the quiet conviction of the INFP meet at the same hour of an evening, when no one else is watching and the wheel still has to come out true.
